description: The chat header's file and changes panel trigger was an icon-only button without an accessible name. The adjacent share icon also relied on tooltip text instead of an explicit button label.
expected: Header icon buttons that open files, changes, or sharing should expose clear accessible labels and state-specific labels where the action toggles a panel.
actual: The file/changes trigger appeared as an unlabeled icon button in the interactive tree before the fix, making the files and diffs path hard to discover by keyboard or screen-reader users.
suggested_fix: Add explicit aria-labels to the share button and file/changes panel toggle, with open/close wording for the toggle state.
